svg.aria-label: Barbell Pause Curl, Setup: Stand tall with a shoulder-width palms-up grip and elbows beside your ribs.
svg.title: Barbell Pause Curl, Setup: Stand tall with a shoulder-width palms-up grip and elbows beside your ribs.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Pause Curl, Pause: Curl halfway and hold for two seconds without swinging.
svg.title: Barbell Pause Curl, Pause: Curl halfway and hold for two seconds without swinging.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Pause Curl, Finish: Finish curling toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows beside your ribs.
svg.title: Barbell Pause Curl, Finish: Finish curling toward your shoulders while keeping your elbows beside your ribs.

svg.aria-label: Barbell Pause Curl, Lower: Lower the bar slowly toward your thighs.
svg.title: Barbell Pause Curl, Lower: Lower the bar slowly toward your thighs.
